old_problem: The Master requires 100 main-plus-standby DC cycles, while DeepSeek runs only five generic chassis host-power cycles and cannot prove standby loss. Removing standby may disable the BMC issuing restoration. Procedure names SSIF/SMA while Criteria names FPGA; those non-equivalent branches were also unresolved.
disposition_reason: Retain Pending and Source Conflict for the irreducible OEM power operation. ED-06/ED-18/ED-29 forbid treating generic chassis off/on as run-plus-standby DC-2. The interface wording is conservatively resolved by requiring SSIF, SMA and FPGA on all 100 cycles, but no standard rule identifies the exact standby controller, sequence, discharge proof or external restore path. Guessing could strand the tray. A safe draft is complete; execution remains closed until a versioned exact-platform rail/command/recovery contract exists.
decision_basis: XLSX row 1928, same-row tests.json/DeepSeek, GPT V2, historical record and ED-01 through ED-30 were read. The actual next formal identity was directly opened as Functionality row 1933 / Wistron-BIOS-00465-V003 / d2dfed79cca28c2d.
Exactly 100 cycles remain mandatory; five cycles are preflight only under ED-14.

Standard BMC chassis off/on does not demonstrate standby-domain removal. A controller powered by that domain cannot be assumed to restore itself, so external control and rail observation are essential.
SSIF, SMA and FPGA are independently retained on every cycle, resolving that wording conflict without deleting coverage; this does not cure the missing power semantics.
The runner must atomically seal rail and endpoint evidence and halt on the first anomaly; no retry may hide intermittent failure.
No power, BMC, PDU, protocol, reboot, log, recovery, retry or DUT action was performed.

test_case.test_command: BLOCKED — DO NOT EXECUTE. After the missing signed OEM contract is supplied, bind the exact target and collect complete baseline. For cycles 1-100, use only the approved main-plus-standby state machine; external observation must prove each run/standby OFF, discharge, ordered restoration, console boot and OS Ready state. test_case.pass_fail_basis: No PASS is possible without the OEM rail/command/recovery contract and independent proof of both domains. After unlock, PASS requires 100/100 complete state transitions and every boot, endpoint and health criterion. Five cycles, generic chassis off/on, uptime or AER counts cannot PASS. FAIL on wrong/ambiguous rail, restoration or boot failure, endpoint mismatch, error/data/thermal/power issue, ledger gap or retry censorship; end user owns verdict.

test_case.recovery: On ambiguous or failed rail state, loss of the BMC/control plane, boot timeout, endpoint/error/data/thermal/power anomaly, stop and seal evidence. Use only the OEM-approved external restore path to place rails in the documented safe order; do not improvise AC cycling, another BMC command or retry. Keep workloads stopped and require power/platform owner inspection and release before any continuation.
